blocks.text:
After breakfast, set off for Quilotoa Crater Lake.

On the way, stop at an artisan workshop in Tigua village. The local naïve painting tradition originated here; Andean landscapes are traditionally painted on sheepskin.

Continue into the central Andes along the Pujilí Route, passing through Quilotoa village.

At the crater, visit a viewpoint overlooking the lake and walk through the Indigenous community.

If the whole group wishes, you can descend on foot to the water, go kayaking and return uphill by mule.

Kayaks and mule rides are not included in the price.

Mule rides uphill are offered by local residents. This informal service is generally available until about 3:00 p.m.

Main stops: viewpoints, an Indigenous painting gallery and Quilotoa Crater Lake.

Return to Quito after the excursion.

Overnight at Patio Andaluz 4★. Breakfast included.

blocks.text:
The next part of the journey comprises four days and three nights in the Amazon.

After breakfast, transfer to Quito airport for the flight to Coca. The itinerary at Sacha Lodge may change depending on the weather, guests' interests and physical fitness.

Departure from Quito is expected around 11:00 a.m., subject to change.

The flight over the Andes takes about 30 minutes and brings you to Coca, in the Amazon basin.

In Coca, a box lunch is provided at a private house.

Continue to the river landing and board a motorised canoe. The journey downstream on the Napo River to the Sacha Lodge area takes approximately two hours.

After disembarking, walk for about 30 minutes through the rainforest to Lake Pilchicocha.

Lodge staff will meet you at the lake. The final stretch is by paddle canoe.

Arrival at Sacha Lodge is expected between approximately 3:30 and 4:00 p.m., subject to change.

After check-in, you may visit a small observation tower to watch birds and the sunset. You can also enjoy the lake.

A visit to the butterfly house with a naturalist guide is also planned, where you can see different butterfly species at various stages of their life cycles.

After dinner, choose between a night walk through the rainforest to look for nocturnal wildlife and a quiet canoe excursion on the lake in search of black and spectacled caimans.

Breakfast, box lunch and dinner are included.
